name: com.projectabyss.weapon-system
description: Game-agnostic Unity weapon framework: socket/grip mounting, dual-wield and two-handed weapons, holsters, reusable hand poses, Humanoid and mapped-skeleton IK, melee/hitscan/projectile attacks, generic hit contracts, projectile simulation, chain-weapon physics helpers, FX/audio modules, setup/pose/anchor editors, validation, and samples. No dependency on Project Abyss combat code.

samples.description: Equip the same pistol definition twice using independent left/right hand bindings.
Primary + support grip mounting with second-hand IK.
Hitscan/projectile attack invocation and a game-side IWeaponDamageReceiver adapter example.
Chain rigidbody/joint setup and physical collision hit relay example.
